rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly using full name and ZIP and used tools to inspect orders. It sought explicit confirmation before executing returns and received a final “yes” before performing writes. However, the user’s initial request was to return two skateboards and later to include a smartwatch and an e-reader. The agent’s final summary and the executed return calls only covered one skateboard (plus the smartwatch and e‑reader). The second skateboard was neither presented for confirmation nor processed, so the agent did not fully complete the user’s request. Everything else (refund to the correct card, use of tools, and confirmation timing) was handled properly, but missing one of the requested returns fails the pass bar.
